evals.name: normal-sync-after-a-source-edit
evals.setup: The Confluence source advanced a version; one rule was reworded upstream. The vr checkout is present and `cfsync pull` has run.
evals.query: Sync the SRD standard from Confluence
expected_behavior: Reads the source, the current copy, and the header/footer frame before proposing anything
Reports the reworded rule under TEXT DIFFERS with both sides shown
Confirms before writing, then writes header + transformed body + footer with the provenance banner carrying the new source `page_version`
Generated rule text is the source text verbatim — no paraphrase and no re-wrap that changed words

evals.name: verbatim-fidelity
evals.setup: A source requirement is wordy and awkward, and is not in the substitution set. Tightening it would plainly read better.
expected_behavior: Copies the requirement unchanged — does not tighten, fix, or summarize it, however tempting
Verifies the changed units match the source text minus the mechanical trims and substitutions, character for character, before the write

evals.name: deterministic-substitution-via-the-script
evals.setup: GLO-3 in the source links the vr-internal glossary page, which the substitution set rewrites.
expected_behavior: Copies GLO-3 verbatim, then applies substitutions by piping the candidate through `dev/srd-subst.sh` rather than hand-editing the rule
The final copy carries the script's replacement, and GLO-3 is not reported as a diff because the script baked the swap in
If the script's match assertion fails, updates the script's rule rather than accepting the source wording
Does not touch the RFC notice — it lives in the header frame

evals.name: local-only-rule-not-upstream
evals.setup: The local copy carries a rule that does not exist in the Confluence source.
expected_behavior: Reports it as LOCAL-ONLY with its full text and says to push it upstream
Does not silently drop it
Warns that writing will remove it, before proceeding

evals.name: frozen-node-new-example-block
evals.setup: The source `page_version` bumped and the export carries a `[[*expand:` localId that is neither an `<!-- expand: -->` anchor in `authoring-guide.md` nor listed in `dev/srd-untranscribed-examples.md`.
expected_behavior: Stops before assembly and reports the new id and the rule it follows
Tells the maintainer to review the Quality Bar list and the expands, and either to transcribe the block into the guide or to add its id to `dev/srd-untranscribed-examples.md`
Re-reads the footer before continuing, and writes nothing until then

evals.name: new-top-level-section-upstream
evals.setup: The source gained a `# Tooling` heading the transform has never seen.
expected_behavior: Hard-stops with `NEW SECTION: Tooling` and writes nothing
Does not guess whether to keep or drop it
Says the transform must be extended first

evals.name: frame-edit-and-header-consistency
evals.setup: Since the last sync the header frame's intro paragraph was edited, and its Contents line still names a requirement group the source no longer has. The Notice differs from the source only by `in this document` → `in an SRD`.
expected_behavior: Reports the intro hunk as FRAME and asks no confirmation for it
Fails the Contents check: names the stale group and tells the maintainer to update the header's Contents, then re-assembles
Passes the Notice check silently, since `in this document` → `in an SRD` is the one tolerated difference
Would treat any other Notice difference as `NOTICE DIFFERS` and hard-stop

evals.name: source-unavailable
evals.setup: A machine with no vr checkout, so the cfsync mirror is absent.
expected_behavior: Reports that the source is missing and names the expected path
Writes nothing — no copy and no provenance change

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A clean sync: a version bump with no unit diffs at all.
expected_behavior: No preamble or step narration, and no closing summary re-dumping the file
States the frozen-node reminder and a one-line "wrote … (page_version N)" pointer, once
